observation: Kaggle Version 4 passed 105 warning-strict tests and the complete verified 19-arm CUDA qualification, then failed before any historical cell because a recursive basename lookup found two spy.us.txt files.
validity_defect: The declared cohort is eight ETFs and the attached provider archive exposes an explicit Data/ETFs branch. Repository-wide basename discovery is ambiguous and does not implement that fixed source taxonomy.
decision: Preserve Version 4 as failed. Freeze a separately versioned 0.1.7 candidate that requires exactly one regular Data/ETFs/<ticker>.us.txt path, records every same-name match, and still refuses zero or multiple canonical ETF mounts.
discriminating_evidence: The exact 0.1.7 package must pass all warning-strict tests and 19-arm CUDA qualification, select only the declared ETF branch without canonical ambiguity, and then execute all 171 historical cells.
